description: IMDS credential requests are now retried. Every failed request is retried except a token request rejected with 400 or 403 and a metadata request answered with 403 or 404. `IMDSConfig.retry_strategy`, which was previously unused, now controls these retries. By default it is a `SimpleRetryStrategy` with backoff of 0.25, 0.5 and 1 seconds, making 4 attempts. The new `IMDSConfig.max_attempts` sets the attempt count when no `retry_strategy` is given, and can also be set with `AWS_METADATA_SERVICE_NUM_ATTEMPTS` or the `metadata_service_num_attempts` config setting. The new `IMDSConfig.timeout`, 1 second by default, bounds each IMDS request and can also be set with `AWS_METADATA_SERVICE_TIMEOUT` or the `metadata_service_timeout` config setting. The synchronous default credential chain now gives IMDS its own HTTP client with this timeout as its connect timeout, instead of the shared client. The synchronous resolver now keeps the HTTP client it creates, so the session token is reused across calls. Session tokens now expire after the TTL IMDS returns.
